name: AXIOM
tagline: A foundation for what is next.
description: A systematic identity for an open research platform. An impossible triangle, icy blue, and precisely tracked text suggest complexity made understandable.
heading: space-grotesk
rules: The three sides of the triangle use matching thickness.
Blueprint lines should support structure, not compete with content.
Use glacier for diagram fields and deep logic for explanatory text.

system.concept: Impossible triangular studies, glacial blueprint fields, precise research annotations, and wide-set modern type. Complexity is presented with a deeply legible visual order.
headline: A stronger foundation
for the next question.
features: A useful structure for research that others can understand.
Thoughtful connections between ideas, evidence, and new possibilities.
A practice that makes discovery more open and more useful.
system.layoutNote: Clarity-white technical hero, a glacial triangular study, wide-set titles, and fine blueprint lines. Research details use a strict, readable module grid.
